_comment: Named address ranges of the Crackdown (v1.0, default.xex) image for the inventory. kind: library = statically linked SDK code, replaced as a unit by Any360 (not decompiled); middleware = third-party engine code the title links (physics, AI, vegetation, scripting, video): neither the title's own code nor something Any360 provides, so it stays recompiled or is replaced by the vendor's library for the target, never decompiled function by function; game = the title's own code. Evidence (tools/library_scan.py), three kinds read together: functions with the same sequence of instruction mnemonics (14 instructions or more) as a function of another title, clustered; the strings a range refers to (lis/addi pairs into the decrypted image); the system calls it makes. Each range runs from its first to its last function carrying such evidence, so it may be a little short, not long. What names each: the D3D runtime shares its functions with Test Drive Unlimited's and The Simpsons Game's and holds 'ERR[D3D]: Unanticipated CPU_INTERRUPT' (it starts at 0x826ACC90: the code from 0x826A0000, once counted with it, refers to the game's own sources, zonemanager and RWStudio\game_framework); SpeedTree by its source paths ('\Libraries\Middleware\SpeedTree\Source\...'); D3DX and XGraphics by 'D3DX: (WARN) ...', the HLSL compiler's messages and 'd:\xenon\oct06\core\private\xtl\graphics\xgraphics\ucode\...' (the game compiles shaders at run time), nearly all of it also in The Simpsons Game; Havok by its source paths and messages ('.\collide\mopp\machine\hkMoppAabbCastVirtualMachine.cpp', '** Havok libs built with version [') and by Test Drive Unlimited's Havok; Kynapse by 'Kynogon Spatial graph', 'CPathFinder::FindNextMove::...'; Massive by 'ALLOCATION Failed for CMassiveZoneManager', 'No MASSIVE SG's were returned'; Lua by the messages of Lua 5.0 ('attempt to yield across metamethod/C-call boundary'); Bink by 'Not a Bink file.'; the XDK audio, Xbox Live, CRT and XAPI ranges by the functions they share with the other two titles and their system calls (XAudio* / XMA*, XMsg* / XamVoice*, KeTls* / KeBugCheck, Nt*File). The CRT range holds the register save / restore helpers (0x82ABD000). The import thunks are the addresses generated crackdown_init.cpp binds. libpng 1.0.5 and zlib 1.1.4 by their messages ('Missing IHDR before sRGB', 'NULL row buffer'; 'incorrect header check', 'invalid bit length repeat', 'oversubscribed dynamic bit lengths tree'), the version strings their entry points pass ('1.0.5' from the game's loader, '1.1.4' from png_create_read_struct and inflateInit) and zlib 1.1.4's call chain (inflate, inflate_blocks, inflate_codes, inflate_fast), most of it also in The Simpsons Game; the image holds two other zlib copies (inflate 1.2.3 near 0x826A9C38, another near 0x8280E920). Not named for want of evidence: 0x82A6E938-0x82A7A550 (XeCrypt users and the first libpng functions), 0x829FFC20-0x82A06D00 (between Havok and Kynapse). Ranges outside the list are reported by 1 MB area until symbol recovery names them.
